title: Indian Army TGC-144 January 2027 Online Form
intro: Join Indian Army (Govt. Of India)  has Released Official Notification for Online Application Form for the Technical Graduate Course TGC-144 (January 2027 Course) Recruitment 2026 for 30 Post. Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to Army TGC Jobs. Online Apply Start On May 13, 2026 & Last Date for Application is June 11, 2026. All Eligible & Interested Candidates Can Read Full Notification Before Apply Online Now in the Given Link Below.
importantDates: Payment Mode: No Needed to Pay Application Fee for All Category, Only Fill Online Application Form.
Candidates Passed/ Appearing Engineering Degree in Related Trade.
Only Unmarried Male Candidates Can Apply Online for this Recruitment
To Be Notified: SSB Interview Dates
Maximum Age: 27 Years (Born between 01 Jan 2000 and 01 Jan 2007)
Engineering Degree in relevant stream from recognized University/Institute
Pay Scale: As per Defence Pay Matrix (Level-10) during training + allowances
Selection Process: Shortlisting on Merit + SSB Interview + Medical Examination
Permanent Commission Officer in Indian Army (Technical)
